        "INSERT INTO ads_records (candidate_id, inputs, score, advanced, created_at, retain_until) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",

    for group, advanced in outcomes:
        totals[group] += 1
        selected[group] += int(advanced)
    rates = {group: selected[group] / totals[group] for group in totals}
    best = max(rates.values()) or 1.0
    report = {group: {"selection_rate": rate, "impact_ratio": rate / best,
                      "flagged": rate / best < IMPACT_RATIO_THRESHOLD} for group, rate in rates.items()}
    db.execute("INSERT INTO bias_audits (run_at, report) VALUES (?, ?)",
               (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), json.dumps(report)))
    db.commit()
    return report

    val systemId: String,
    val purpose: String,
    val owner: String,
    val provider: String,
    val model: String,
    val deployedOn: LocalDate,
    val riskTier: String,
)

val AI_SYSTEM_INVENTORY = listOf(
    AiSystem("support-bot", "Answer billing questions", "cx-platform@example.com", "OpenAI", "gpt-4o-mini", LocalDate.of(2025, 9, 1), "limited"),
    AiSystem("claims-summarizer", "Summarize claim files for adjusters", "claims-eng@example.com", "OpenAI", "gpt-4o", LocalDate.of(2026, 1, 15), "high"),
).associateBy { it.systemId }

fun exportInventory(): List<Map<String, Any?>> = AI_SYSTEM_INVENTORY.values.map { mapper.convertValue<Map<String, Any?>>(it) + ("deployed_on" to it.deployedOn.toString()) }

fun complete(systemId: String, messages: List<ChatCompletionMessageParam>): String {
    val system = AI_SYSTEM_INVENTORY[systemId]
        ?: throw NoSuchElementException("AI system '$systemId' is not in the inventory; register it before deploying")
    val resp = client.chat().completions().create(ChatCompletionCreateParams.builder().model(system.model).messages(messages).build())
    return resp.choices()[0].message().content().orElse("")
}

note: Java: frozen dataclass -> record; asdict + isoformat date -> Jackson convertValue with JavaTimeModule (ISO dates); LookupError -> NoSuchElementException | Kotlin: frozen dataclass -> data class; dict comprehension -> associateBy; asdict -> Jackson convertValue; LookupError -> NoSuchElementException
Java: official OpenAI Java SDK; two plain static methods | Kotlin: openai-java client used from Kotlin
